table_title: Table 9.11.3.18B.1: QoS mndf data container information element
rows: QoS mndf data container contents (octet 3 to octet 3+7)
These octets include user data to be delivered between UE and AMF.
When the Data type is "Control plane user data" the PDU session identity and Qosflows data indication QCIs fields are encoded as follows:
Data associated with the user plane data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected
Only a control signaling data transmission or no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected
The QCI field is only used in the UE to network direction.
This field contains the control path user data.
When Data type is "SMS", data 1 to 4 of octet 4 are spare and shall be coded as zero
This field contains an SMS message.
When the Data type is "Location services message container":
This field is encoded as described above for the case when the Data type is "Control plane user data".
See 3.17.1 of TS 24.080 and TS 24.071 for the data.

When the Data type is not "Control plane user data", bits 5 to 6 of octet 3 are spare and octet 3+n, bits 1 to 4 (n<3) are spare; and bits 1 to 4 indication the length, in octets, of the Additional Information field.
Contains additional information if provided by the upper layer location services application.
This field is location services message payload.
